activity_context.topic_title: Joint Distributions for Discrete Random Variables

feedback.problem:
|  | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ | $Y=3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $a$ | $2a$ | $a$ |
| $X=1$ | $3a$ | $a$ | $2a$ |

The joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ for the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ is given above. Find the value of $a.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The support of $X$ is ${S}_{X}={0,1},$ the support of $Y$ is ${S}_{Y}={1,2,3},$ and therefore the joint support $S$ is

$$
S={S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}={(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,1),(1,2),(1,3)}.
$$

Since we're given a joint probability distribution $f(x,y),$ we must have 

$$
{\sum }_{(x,y)\in S}f(x,y)=1.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}f(0,1)+f(0,2)+f(0,3)+f(1,1)+f(1,2)+f(1,3) & =1 \\ a+2a+a+3a+a+2a & =1 \\ 10a & =1 \\ a & =\frac{1}{10}.\end{aligned}
$$
